response.inner_monologue: I left before the stay bonus vested and I am not going to pretend that doesn't sting. But I am also not going to pretend I made the wrong call — I was building toward this exit since tick 0 and the dealership closed anyway. The difference is I have a client and a methodology and a network. I need two more clients in the next 30 days or the runway math collapses. That is the number I live inside right now. Not drama. Just math.
